Position Summary...
   

  

 What you'll do...
   

  

 As a Software Engineer III at Walmart, you will lead the design and development of scalable software solutions by collaborating with cross\-functional teams including product management and user experience. You will troubleshoot complex issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement sustainable solutions while ensuring high\-quality code and adherence to security standards.  About the team:
   

  

 The Subscriptions Team supports one of the largest e\-commerce platforms globally, managing critical systems that process billions of transactions annually with high reliability and speed. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define high\-level design and technical solutions for projects.
* Develop, test, and maintain scalable, secure, and high\-quality software components and applications.
* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues through root cause analysis and effective action plans.
* Lead small engineering groups by providing guidance, documentation, and mentorship.
* Implement automation scripts to support continuous integration and delivery processes.
* Ensure adherence to coding standards, security policies, and quality requirements.
* Monitor application performance and participate in defect management and regression testing.
* Support business needs by evaluating technical feasibility and recommending solutions.

* 4\+ years of experience in software development, with 3\+ years in Android development Kotlin
* Experience developing and testing Serverside APIs for mobile and web clients using Node.js, Java, Go, etc. GraphQL APIs using Apollo is a plus.

* Familiarity with public cloud technologies such as Azure
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex projects, translating requirements into scalable, maintainable solutions.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure.

**The role** 




 This team is building AI systems that help customers better understand, evaluate, and improve their AI applications. The role sits at the intersection of product engineering, infrastructure, and applied AI, with the opportunity to shape how AI is integrated across the platform.
 



 This is an extremely high\-agency role. You'll touch every part of the stack (simulations, UI, API, CLI) and help determine where AI belongs and, just as importantly, where it doesn't. Rather than building a simple chatbot or assistant, you'll develop AI systems with optimized tool calling, memory, retrieval, and data access that deliver meaningful value to customers.
 



  





**Here's what that looks like in practice:** 



* Building agentic AI experiences across the platform. You'll help determine which workflows belong in the UI, which should be powered by LLMs, and where AI can create the most value for customers.
* Developing production\-grade AI systems by optimizing retrieval, tool calling, memory, and context management to deliver fast, reliable, and actionable insights.
* Staying at the forefront of AI advancements by evaluating new models, understanding emerging architectures, and helping shape technical direction as the ecosystem evolves.
* Driving AI adoption internally by improving engineering workflows, tooling, and best practices while serving as a technical resource for the broader team.



  





**Qualifications:** 



* Deep understanding of modern AI systems, including LLMs, prompt engineering, evaluation, tool calling, retrieval, and memory.
* Strong curiosity and product intuition, with the ability to identify where AI meaningfully improves user experiences.
* High agency and ownership, with the ability to identify problems, propose solutions, and execute with minimal direction.
* Experience shipping AI\-powered features into production, with an understanding of what it takes to build reliable, customer\-facing AI systems.
* Interest in staying current with the rapidly evolving AI landscape and applying new capabilities thoughtfully.
* Comfortable working across the full stack when needed. This is a product engineering role focused on shipping, not a research position.



  





**Tech stack:** 




 The team primarily works in Python to build AI systems on top of modern LLM APIs and cloud infrastructure. Depending on the project, you'll also contribute across the TypeScript frontend. The engineering culture emphasizes rapid iteration, strong developer tooling, and shipping quickly.
